force_teacher_https_exit sets terminate_required=true, invokes begin_shutdown, then restores Faulted and clamps shutdown_deadline to min(existing, expired). StopTimeout passes Instant::now, already expired by the later main-pump deadline test.

The external C stop interval also uses its original stop_deadline and passes that already expired instant to force_teacher_https_exit. begin_shutdown cannot replace the final clamped value with a later fresh5s interval in this call order.

faultedOrdering.detail: force_teacher_https_exit calls begin_shutdown before setting readiness Faulted and clamping deadline. begin_shutdown may temporarily set Stopping, but final readiness in this function is Faulted. detail: Probe creates the independent TeacherAdmin through actual native form account creation/password change with scope class1/subject1; pairing is not issued to the setup global administrator.

Saved host/port/certificate/source policy go through native settings commands. Enable goes through App ordinary RuntimeOwner and configured host, not direct set_enabled or a replacement probe listener.

Pairing BEGIN, coherent REFRESH, actual request ComboBox selection and native APPROVE are normal app commands. External runner submits actual HTTPS pairing request and polls, verifies secure host-only cookie, exact TeacherAdmin principal2 and assignments, then performs authenticated session/scopes/reminder GET, reminder POST with CSRF, readback GET and durable receipt GET.

Both generations verify owned IP-SAN certificate with CERT_REQUIRED/check_hostname and TLS1.2, and require actual clean TLS EOF. Finite loopback composition, not campus or Win7/10 proof. MaterialReady stop remains explicitly NOT_EXERCISED in this ordinary probe; B separate regression covers it.
Teacher initial and changed passwords are randomly generated SecretText passed only to native forms, dropped after use; native transcript prints fixed step labels/public rendezvous metadata.

Actual pairing code is written only to a fresh owned ACL-inheriting transient .secret sidechannel. read_pairing_secret uses direct subprocess capture into memory outside Remote.run_file raw recorder, removes the exact remote file before delivery, and reports no code/digest/body.

HTTP cookie/CSRF/poll secret and response JSON remain memory-only; event records contain status, lengths, route and boolean cookie/csrf presence. authenticate_and_write returns only fixed approval/readback/receipt metadata. Secret-bearing response body hashes are not added to events.

Raw capture allowlist does not include .secret; cleanup attempts removal before root raw preservation. Reports may archive control source code and public certificate metadata but not runtime authentication values.

Failure messages in ordinary parser/validator are static; common tls.failure preserves error strings, so this assessment relies on the observed paths not formatting request/response bodies or captured secret stdout into raised messages. Runtime evidence still needs an actual secret scan before archiving.

independentOpenFinding.detail: physical_returned marks returned=true and clears shared runtime_owned. If a new reservation sets runtime_owned=true while an old returned RuntimeOwner/Arc still exists, dropping that old reservation again clears runtime_owned due returned branch. C normally drops its old owner before preparing new start, but this is not an exact-owner release invariant and must be fixed before promotion. Source frozen and not changed by this reviewer.
